s: This technical article outlines a book focused on building a future-proof tech stack centered around 'localhost' principles. It advocates for timeless tools like Linux, Python, Vim, and Git (LPvg), coupled with modern approaches like NixOS, HTMX, FastHTML, and local AI (LLMs), emphasizing digital sovereignty and efficient workflows.
sub: The 'localhost revolution' and reclaiming digital sovereignty.
Leveraging the LPvg stack (Linux, Python, Vim, Git) for timeless tech skills.
Building modern web applications with HTMX, FastHTML, and server-side state management.
Integrating local Large Language Models (LLMs) for enhanced productivity and collaboration.
